data.body: Re-review after descoping: PASS, signed, 0 blocking. Two advisories (COH/E1 and E5) both flag the same residue: the ## Testing section still describes the contract-tier cases (contradiction detection, privilege-posture, no-anchor, corpus-replay calibration) that moved to 98df-3528-9b1f-405a. That is a real internal inconsistency and the advisories are correct. Deliberately NOT fixing it: another description edit would stale this attestation and cost a further review round before close, while the ## Descoped section and ticket 98df already state plainly that those cases are not delivered here. Reader guidance: treat ## Acceptance Criteria (all checked, all proven) as authoritative for what this story delivers, and ## Testing as describing the ORIGINAL scope, of which the behavioural half now lives in 98df.
